task.pr_title: ES|QL: Extend match on runtime expressions to all supported types

cases.provenance: A human reviewer flagged this defect in an inline comment on the reviewed pull request.

evidence.thread_resolution:
ioanatia: I added an assertion here because if `queryObject` is not a `Long`, we should treat this case as a bug.
Raising an exception (depending on the type), can sometimes lead to the error being treated as a user error and returned as a 400.
But I tested and throwing `EsqlIllegalArgumentException.illegalDataType` here would actually lead to a 500, so I will change it.
